scientific_integrity: Exact identities and single-time obstruction are independently verified by symbolic checker and supported by analytic proof; numerical check is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the adjacency continuous-time walk on the unweighted six-cycle; proves exact optimal number of sampled observation times, not uniqueness, perturbation stability, or general cycle classification. Potential equivalent formulations in unlocated literature remain an originality risk.
title: Exact optimal two-time randomized uniform mixing on the six-cycle
